User_Story: As a Sales Executive, I want to register customer details so that customer information is stored centrally.
Acceptance_Criteria: Customer name is mandatory; Contact number is mandatory; Email must follow a valid format when provided; System generates a unique Customer ID; Successfully saved customers appear in the customer list.

User_Story: As a Sales Executive, I want to create customer leads so that every enquiry can be tracked.
Acceptance_Criteria: System generates a unique Lead ID; Customer details must be linked to the lead; Lead source is mandatory; Lead creation date is recorded; New leads appear in the lead list.

User_Story: As a Sales Executive, I want the system to identify possible duplicate leads so that multiple executives do not contact the same customer unnecessarily.
Acceptance_Criteria: System checks existing leads using the contact number; Possible duplicates are flagged before saving; User can review matching records; Duplicate warning is displayed clearly.

User_Story: As a Sales Manager, I want to assign leads to sales executives so that each lead has clear ownership.
Acceptance_Criteria: Manager can select an available sales executive; Each lead can have only one active owner; Assignment date is recorded; Assigned executive can view their leads.

User_Story: As a Sales Executive, I want to record customer follow-ups so that communication history is maintained.
Acceptance_Criteria: User can record follow-up date; User can enter notes; Next follow-up date can be selected; Follow-up history is linked to the lead; Follow-up records display in chronological order.

User_Story: As a Sales Manager, I want to identify overdue follow-ups so that pending customer enquiries are not missed.
Acceptance_Criteria: System identifies leads with follow-up dates earlier than the current date; Completed or closed leads are excluded; Manager can view overdue leads; Overdue records show assigned executive details.

User_Story: As a Site Engineer, I want to view and update site inspection schedules so that inspection activities are tracked.
Acceptance_Criteria: Inspection must be linked to an existing lead; Inspection date is mandatory; Engineer details are recorded; Inspection status can be updated; Completed inspections retain their completion date.

User_Story: As an Operations Manager, I want to track installation progress so that I can monitor project execution.
Acceptance_Criteria: Installation must be linked to an approved quotation; Installation start date and planned completion date are recorded; Status follows defined workflow stages; Actual completion date is recorded when completed.

User_Story: As a Support Executive, I want to create and update support tickets so that customer complaints can be managed centrally.
Acceptance_Criteria: System generates a unique Ticket ID; Ticket is linked to a customer; Issue description is mandatory; Ticket status can be updated; Resolved tickets require a resolution date.

User_Story: As an Operations Manager, I want to view a business performance dashboard so that I can monitor operational performance.
Acceptance_Criteria: Dashboard displays total leads; Dashboard displays lead conversion rate; Dashboard displays inspection completion rate; Dashboard displays installation status; Dashboard displays open and resolved support tickets.
